summary: LightPath Technologies filed Form 8-K regarding a combined primary and secondary offering of 7,142,800 shares at $14.00 per share. The company sold 3,571,400 primary shares for ~$50M gross proceeds; the selling stockholder sold 3,571,400 secondary shares. The offering closed June 3, 2026; net proceeds ~$47M for working capital and acquisitions. No board recommendation or advisor named besides placement agent Craig-Hallum. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
